quests.title: Cleaning the Comb

quests.accept_text: Inside the Lair, around the Web Heart. Hatchlings first. The weavers sit above them and spit.
quests.turn_in_text: Fewer legs. That's the best thing I can say about the Lair right now. Take this.

quests.turn_in_text: No more eggs. For the first time since the plague, the woods will have fewer legs than last year. Thank you.

quests.title: Moon-Touched
quests.description: Arugal's cult is half sorcerers and half worgen who haven't yet decided. Rynn calls them moonwalkers and darksouls, and says the keep teems with them. She wants twelve of them down.
quests.accept_text: All through the keep, wherever you hear chanting. Casters first.
quests.turn_in_text: Fewer chants. Perhaps the moon will go unremarked tonight.

quests.title: The Haunted Cloister
quests.description: West of the Great Hall a stone cloister runs to Fenrus' crypt, and nobody has walked it in years. Marl wants it walked, start to end, by someone who'll tell him whether the crypt door is open.
quests.accept_text: Out of the west door of the Great Hall, down the cloister, into the crypt.
quests.turn_in_text: Open. I'd hoped. I'd feared. Both, honestly.

quests.title: Fenrus the Devourer
quests.description: Fenrus was Arugal's first experiment and his least successful. He devours things in the crypt, and nothing that goes in comes out. Marl would like to be the exception.
quests.accept_text: In the crypt, at the end of the cloister. Mind the sarcophagi. They breathe.
quests.turn_in_text: He ate his handler, and then his handler's replacement. Thank you for being the exception.

quests.title: Arugal's Get
quests.description: The inner keep is stocked with Arugal's best: Sons of Arugal in half-turned shapes, Lupine Horrors that don't fit through doors, and Deathsworn Captains who command them. Rynn will not call them a pack.
quests.accept_text: The crypt, the armoury and the upper landing. Don't fight them in a corridor.
quests.turn_in_text: Not a pack. A cult, with fangs. Fewer of those is a victory.

quests.title: The Archmage's Folly
quests.description: Archmage Arugal opened the door that let the worgen into Lordaeron, and now sits at the top of the keep with his tower of shadow. Marl has stood at his gate for years and would like to see the other side of it.
quests.accept_text: The upper landing, and then the Sanctum. Don't stop. Don't answer when he speaks.
quests.turn_in_text: Arugal, dead. I'll lock the gate and sit for a while. Thank you. You'll never need to buy a drink at my post.
